findings.observation: Observed: TapTap distinguishes H5 (web content deployed on a platform domain; use the MiniGame MCP route) from the non-DOM Tap MiniGame JS VM. The H5 MCP setup says MCP currently supports H5; the H5 ad guide says H5 ads are supported and requires developer verification, a complete financial entity, and per-game ad enablement, but does not specify the H5 callable API, ad callbacks, lifecycle callbacks, archive internals, or H5 package-size limit. The current adapter calls `tap.createRewardedVideoAd`. The exact documented contract for `tap.createRewardedVideoAd({adUnitId})`, `show()` Promise, `load`, `onLoad`, `onError(err)`, `onClose(res)` and reward only when `res.isEnded === true`, plus `tap.onShow(listener)`, belongs to standard Tap MiniGame docs; its overview says that runtime has no BOM/DOM/window and lists a 60 MB total package cap. These MiniGame details cannot be treated as an H5 contract. The H5 CLI does document an H5 ZIP upload, but no H5 ZIP is present in this run. Unknown: H5 ad bridge/API, lifecycle, archive schema, and size limit.
evidence: TapTap [AI developer guide](https://developer.taptap.cn/agents/) distinguishes H5 from Tap MiniGame and directs H5 to the MiniGame MCP, not APK SDK (consulted 2026-10-20).

[MCP setup](https://developer.taptap.cn/minigameapidoc/quick-start/mcp-guide/mcp-setup/) §scope and [ad integration guide](https://developer.taptap.cn/minigameapidoc/quick-start/mcp-guide/ad-integration-guide/) §§1-2 (consulted 2026-10-20).

Standard MiniGame-only API and environment: [overview](https://developer.taptap.cn/minigameapidoc/dev/tutorial/overview/) §§Tap API, global objects, package limits; [rewarded video API](https://developer.taptap.cn/minigameapidoc/dev/tutorial/open-capabilities/ad/rewarded-video-ad/); [tap.onShow lifecycle API](https://developer.taptap.cn/minigameapidoc/dev/api/base/app/life-cycle/tap.onShow/) (consulted 2026-10-20).

Current adapter: runs/h5-qq-mobile-20261013/workspace/game/themes.mjs. CLI help says `Upload an H5 zip and create an H5 version`; output `/tmp/taptap-h5-upload-final.txt`. No target-run `.zip` was found.
findings.recommendation: Keep the smallest-fit DOM/WebGL H5 route: package the current H5 build as an H5 ZIP and use the H5 MCP/account-generated contract for ads and lifecycle. Do not port to the non-DOM VM merely to reuse its API examples. Until H5-specific API/callbacks, required archive layout/size, and live H5 behavior are confirmed, keep ads/platform readiness unclaimed; run an authorized H5 live test before enabling the bridge.
